title: The Dusk Boundary Canon
summary: A canon on holding dark and light edge to edge at the line where each ends so that a foe cannot say which one strikes him.

title: Treatise on the Joined Black and Bright
summary: A treatise on the formed core as the seat of two streams of dark and light that are bound into one blow of strange power.

title: Manual of the Twin Perceptions
summary: A manual of dark that hides and light that shows turned on one foe together until sight and sense both lose the true shape.
